description: The report of SET sit-ins at some schools gives no attendance, number of sites, or wording sufficient to establish 50 people at any individual public gathering. The reported nationwide strike is not itself proof of a qualifying gathering.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous school- or locality-specific accounts with direct attendance evidence before resolving the 50-person threshold.

description: The 22 January Lome Gazette article pairs “since Monday” sit-ins with a strike “since yesterday Tuesday,” inconsistent with its Friday publication date. Later announced SET dates also vary between 25–26 January and 28–29 January; cancellation/suspension reports do not verify execution on those dates.
required_followup: Locate independent contemporaneous reports, original SET notices, or dated records that resolve the sit-in start, strike start and separation between the actual report and later calls.

description: No event-specific state reception or coercive response to the reported school sit-ins/strike is established. Arrests at a 20 January union-office meeting precede the imprecisely dated action; later ministry warnings refer to planned activity and cannot be assigned as responses to an executed gathering. S052 reports the 22 January school-monitoring letter as part of the dispute around the proposed strike; the temporal relation to the actual, imprecisely dated sit-ins is unresolved.
required_followup: Find reports tied to the actual date and site(s) of any sit-in or strike before coding a state-response field.

description: The January union-office arrest accounts overlap: the Synergie-Togo statement attributes details to the STT coordinator and the archive repeats that statement; the separate news report also covers the same meeting. The accounts do not independently establish a public mass gathering or turnout.
required_followup: Preserve source attribution and compare any later reporting for genuinely independent witnesses; do not count republication or arrests as attendance evidence.

description: Lomé University researchers reportedly decided on 20 November 2020 to suspend academic/pedagogical activity until demands were met, but reviewed December coverage does not establish whether work stoppage or any physical gathering continued into January. Separate February nurse sit-ins and February dockworker action are outside this unit and do not prove January continuation.
required_followup: Search dated January 2021 university notices and independent reporting for actual continuation, resumption or end; keep February actions in their own month.

description: ILO complaint record S003 returned HTTP 403 and was not retried or replaced through another language, mirror or bypass. The Dapaong student lead S024 returned HTTP 406 with an empty body and its article date and event details remain unknown; no further access attempt was made. A later exact-title search result displays 1 December 2016, but the blocked original was not reopened and that indexed date is not promoted to verified source metadata.
required_followup: If the source becomes ordinarily accessible, inspect only the public original pages and record exact retrieval status and scope; otherwise retain the access limitation. Do not retry the already-blocked original or use an alternate copy to bypass it; retain the indexed date as a discovery clue only.

description: Explicit Ewe/Eʋegbe and Kabiyè/Kabiye discovery searches returned predominantly French/reference material and no captured local-language article. This measures searchable results only and does not establish absence of local-language reporting or events.
required_followup: Where suitable public indexes or sources are available, seek local-language reporting and document whether any source can be interpreted reliably; do not infer a negative event finding from the current searches.

description: Open-web discovery covered general French/English terms, each January week, teacher/union, health, agriculture, political opposition, local-language terms, and a university December–January boundary. Results and reviewed reports are uneven by sector and geography; no fixed query count establishes completeness. No January farmer action was verified in this search, but absence is not established.
required_followup: Continue targeted regional and sectoral discovery, especially outside Lomé and for worker/health/education reporting, and record any newly consulted source with its original access evidence.

description: Research used open-web searches and inspected public pages/PDFs; LexisNexis was unavailable under the current protocol. Web result headers are discovery leads only, and search coverage is not exhaustive.
required_followup: If licensed database access becomes available under protocol, search the same month and retain separate database query and source-access records.

description: The official historical baseline, source universe, and any applicable original coding reference remain unverified for this unit; local provisional candidate work is not approved for integration.
required_followup: Coordinator to resolve the official baseline/version and coding reference before comparison with the legacy official dataset, official ID assignment, integration, or contribution. Provisional candidate reconciliation, consolidation, and working exports may proceed while the baseline gate remains pending.

description: Official-hosted issue S051 was retrievable as a PDF and its text could be read, but the issue publication date and the date of the “Reprise des cours à l’Université de Lomé” story were not established. It contains contextual references that make a January 2021 attribution unsafe.
required_followup: Locate verifiable issue metadata or a date-specific original report before using this PDF to resolve the university continuation timeline.

description: A February 20 Lome Gazette report is dated outside the unit; its page body was not isolated in the earlier retrieval and a later web-open returned cache miss. The indexed search excerpt says SET teachers had gone on strike in recent weeks but gives no exact dates; it is a boundary lead only and cannot resolve the January candidate chronology.
required_followup: If the original page body becomes ordinarily readable, check exact dates and any January references without treating the February article or planned Atakpamé assembly as a January gathering; do not use the search snippet as body evidence.
